#!/usr/bin/env bun
// @bun @bun-cjs
(function(exports, require, module, __filename, __dirname) {"use strict";
var __defProp = Object.defineProperty;
var __getOwnPropNames = Object.getOwnPropertyNames;
var __getOwnPropDesc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor;
var __hasOwnProp = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty;
function __accessProp(key) {
  return this[key];
}
var __toCommonJS = (from) => {
  var entry = (__moduleCache ??= new WeakMap).get(from), desc;
  if (entry)
    return entry;
  entry = __defProp({}, "__esModule", { value: true });
  if (from && typeof from === "object" || typeof from === "function") {
    for (var key of __getOwnPropNames(from))
      if (!__hasOwnProp.call(entry, key))
        __defProp(entry, key, {
          get: __accessProp.bind(from, key),
          enumerable: !(desc = __getOwnPropDesc(from, key)) || desc.enumerable
        });
  }
  __moduleCache.set(from, entry);
  return entry;
};
var __moduleCache;
var __commonJS = (cb, mod) => () => (mod || cb((mod = { exports: {} }).exports, mod), mod.exports);
var __returnValue = (v) => v;
function __exportSetter(name, newValue) {
  this[name] = __returnValue.bind(null, newValue);
}
var __export = (target, all) => {
  for (var name in all)
    __defProp(target, name, {
      get: all[name],
      enumerable: true,
      configurable: true,
      set: __exportSetter.bind(all, name)
    });
};
var __esm = (fn, res, err) => () => {
  if (fn)
    try {
      res = fn(fn = 0);
    } catch (e) {
      err = [e];
    }
  if (err)
    throw err[0];
  return res;
};

// packages/pc-agent/src/daemon/held.js
var require_held = __commonJS(function(exports2, module2) {
  function heldModule(load) {
    const fs = load("node:fs");
    const path = load("node:path");
    const util = load("node:util");
    const { O_DIRECTORY, O_NOFOLLOW, O_RDONLY } = fs.constants;
    const O_PATH = 2097152;
    function movedUnderneath(judged, cause) {
      const error = new Error(`device path '${judged}' changed after it was checked: a directory in it is now a link`);
      error.code = "EACCES";
      error.cause = cause;
      return error;
    }
    function entryAt(at, follow = 0) {
      return {
        open: (flags, mode) => fs.openSync(at, flags | follow, mode),
        mkdir: (recursive) => {
          fs.mkdirSync(at, { recursive });
        },
        unlink: () => {
          fs.unlinkSync(at);
        },
        rmdir: () => {
          fs.rmdirSync(at);
        },
        stat: () => fs.lstatSync(at, { throwIfNoEntry: false }),
        list: (read) => read(fs.readdirSync(at, { withFileTypes: true }).map((entry) => listed(entry.name, entry, () => fs.lstatSync(path.join(at, entry.name), { throwIfNoEntry: false }))))
      };
    }
    function listed(name, dirent, stat) {
      return { name, isDirectory: () => dirent.isDirectory(), isSymbolicLink: () => dirent.isSymbolicLink(), stat };
    }
    function procEntry(dir, name, shown) {
      const at = `/proc/self/fd/${dir}/${name}`;
      const entry = entryAt(at, O_NOFOLLOW);
      const named = (call) => (...args) => {
        try {
          return call(...args);
        } catch (cause) {
          if (typeof cause.path === "string") {
            cause.message = cause.message.split(cause.path).join(shown);
            cause.path = shown;
          }
          throw cause;
        }
      };
      return {
        openDir: named(() => fs.openSync(at, O_PATH | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW)),
        exists: () => fs.existsSync(at),
        isLink: () => fs.lstatSync(at, { throwIfNoEntry: false })?.isSymbolicLink() === true,
        open: named(entry.open),
        mkdir: named(entry.mkdir),
        unlink: named(entry.unlink),
        rmdir: named(entry.rmdir),
        stat: named(() => fs.lstatSync(at, { throwIfNoEntry: false })),
        list: named((read) => {
          const held = fs.openSync(at, O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW);
          try {
            const through = `/proc/self/fd/${held}`;
            return read(fs.readdirSync(through, { withFileTypes: true }).map((child) => listed(child.name, child, () => fs.lstatSync(`${through}/${child.name}`, { throwIfNoEntry: false }))));
          } finally {
            fs.closeSync(held);
          }
        })
      };
    }
    const procRoot = () => fs.openSync("/", O_PATH | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW);
    const DARWIN_O_SEARCH = 1073741824 | O_DIRECTORY;
    const DARWIN_O_CLOEXEC = 16777216;
    const DARWIN_AT_REMOVEDIR = 128;
    const DARWIN_AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW = 32;
    const DARWIN_FSTATAT = process.arch === "x64" ? "fstatat$INODE64" : "fstatat";
    const DARWIN_STAT_BYTES = 144;
    const S_IFMT = 61440;
    function darwinStat(buffer) {
      const mode = buffer.readUInt16LE(4);
      const kind = mode & S_IFMT;
      return {
        mode,
        size: Number(buffer.readBigInt64LE(96)),
        mtimeMs: Number(buffer.readBigInt64LE(48)) * 1000 + Number(buffer.readBigInt64LE(56)) / 1e6,
        isSymbolicLink: () => kind === fs.constants.S_IFLNK,
        isDirectory: () => kind === fs.constants.S_IFDIR,
        isFile: () => kind === fs.constants.S_IFREG
      };
    }
    let libSystem = null;
    function darwinCalls() {
      if (libSystem !== null)
        return libSystem;
      const { dlopen, read } = load("bun:ffi");
      const { symbols } = dlopen("/usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib", {
        openat: { args: ["i32", "buffer", "i32", "u32", "u64", "u64", "u64", "u64", "u64"], returns: "i32" },
        mkdirat: { args: ["i32", "buffer", "u16"], returns: "i32" },
        unlinkat: { args: ["i32", "buffer", "i32"], returns: "i32" },
        faccessat: { args: ["i32", "buffer", "i32", "i32"], returns: "i32" },
        readlinkat: { args: ["i32", "buffer", "buffer", "u64"], returns: "i64" },
        [DARWIN_FSTATAT]: { args: ["i32", "buffer", "buffer", "i32"], returns: "i32" },
        __error: { args: [], returns: "ptr" }
      });
      const failure = (syscall, shown) => {
        const errno = read.i32(symbols.__error(), 0);
        const code = util.getSystemErrorName(-errno);
        return Object.assign(new Error(`${code}: ${util.getSystemErrorMessage(-errno)}, ${syscall} '${shown}'`), {
          errno: -errno,
          code,
          syscall,
          path: shown
        });
      };
      libSystem = {
        symbols,
        failure,
        openat: (dir, name, flags, mode) => symbols.openat(dir, name, flags | DARWIN_O_CLOEXEC, mode, 0, 0, 0, 0, mode),
        lstatAt: (dir, name, shown) => {
          const buffer = Buffer.alloc(DARWIN_STAT_BYTES);
          if (symbols[DARWIN_FSTATAT](dir, name, buffer, DARWIN_AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW) === 0)
            return darwinStat(buffer);
          const cause = failure("lstat", shown);
          if (cause.code === "ENOENT")
            return;
          throw cause;
        }
      };
      return libSystem;
    }
    function darwinEntry(dir, name, shown) {
      if (name.includes("\x00")) {
        throw Object.assign(new TypeError(`The argument 'path' must be a string, Uint8Array, or URL without null bytes. Received ${JSON.stringify(shown)}`), {
          code: "ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE"
        });
      }
      const { symbols, failure, openat, lstatAt } = darwinCalls();
      const bytes = Buffer.from(`${name}\x00`);
      const ok = (result, syscall) => {
        if (result < 0)
          throw failure(syscall, shown);
        return result;
      };
      return {
        openDir: () => ok(openat(dir, bytes, DARWIN_O_SEARCH | O_NOFOLLOW, 0), "open"),
        exists: () => symbols.faccessat(dir, bytes, 0, 0) === 0,
        isLink: () => symbols.readlinkat(dir, bytes, Buffer.alloc(1), 1) >= 0,
        open: (flags, mode = 438) => ok(openat(dir, bytes, flags | O_NOFOLLOW, mode), "open"),
        mkdir: (recursive) => {
          if (symbols.mkdirat(dir, bytes, 511) === 0)
            return;
          const cause = failure("mkdir", shown);
          if (!recursive || cause.code !== "EEXIST" || symbols.faccessat(dir, Buffer.from(`${name}/\x00`), 0, 0) !== 0)
            throw cause;
        },
        unlink: () => {
          ok(symbols.unlinkat(dir, bytes, 0), "unlink");
        },
        rmdir: () => {
          ok(symbols.unlinkat(dir, bytes, DARWIN_AT_REMOVEDIR), "rmdir");
        },
        stat: () => lstatAt(dir, bytes, shown),
        list: (read) => {
          const held = ok(openat(dir, bytes, DARWIN_O_SEARCH | O_NOFOLLOW, 0), "open");
          try {
            return read(fs.readdirSync(shown).flatMap((child) => {
              const stat = child.includes("\x00") ? undefined : lstatAt(held, Buffer.from(`${child}\x00`), path.join(shown, child));
              return stat === undefined ? [] : [{ name: child, isDirectory: () => stat.isDirectory(), isSymbolicLink: () => stat.isSymbolicLink(), stat: () => stat }];
            }));
          } finally {
            fs.closeSync(held);
          }
        }
      };
    }
    const darwinRoot = () => fs.openSync("/", O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY);
    function atJudged(view, judged, { createParents = false } = {}, act) {
      if (view.raw === true) {
        if (createParents)
          fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(judged), { recursive: true });
        return act(entryAt(judged));
      }
      const darwin = process.platform === "darwin";
      const entryOf = darwin ? darwinEntry : procEntry;
      let fd = darwin ? darwinRoot() : procRoot();
      try {
        for (const name of path.dirname(judged).split("/").filter((part) => part !== "")) {
          const next = entryOf(fd, name, judged);
          let opened;
          try {
            if (createParents && !next.exists())
              next.mkdir(false);
            opened = next.openDir();
          } catch (cause) {
            if (next.isLink())
              throw movedUnderneath(judged, cause);
            throw cause;
          }
          fs.closeSync(fd);
          fd = opened;
        }
        return act(entryOf(fd, path.basename(judged), judged));
      } finally {
        fs.closeSync(fd);
      }
    }
    return { atJudged, movedUnderneath };
  }
  module2.exports = { ...heldModule(require), heldModule };
});

// packages/pc-agent/src/daemon/log.js
var require_log = __commonJS(function(exports2, module2) {
  function log(...a) {
    console.log(new Date().toISOString(), ...a);
  }
  function errorDetail(err) {
    const message = err?.message;
    return message === undefined || message === "" ? err : message;
  }
  module2.exports = { log, errorDetail };
});

// packages/core/src/execution/bounded-output.ts
function elidedOutput(kept) {
  const { head, tail, total, stream, where } = kept;
  const continues = (byte) => ((byte ?? 0) & 192) === 128;
  let headEnd = head.length;
  for (let lead = head.length - 1;lead >= Math.max(0, head.length - 4); lead--) {
    const byte = head[lead] ?? 0;
    if (continues(byte))
      continue;
    let size = 1;
    if (byte >= 240)
      size = 4;
    else if (byte >= 224)
      size = 3;
    else if (byte >= 192)
      size = 2;
    if (lead + size > head.length)
      headEnd = lead;
    break;
  }
  let tailStart = 0;
  while (tailStart < Math.min(3, tail.length) && continues(tail[tailStart]))
    tailStart++;
  const omitted = total - headEnd - (tail.length - tailStart);
  const decoder = new TextDecoder;
  return `${decoder.decode(head.subarray(0, headEnd))}
[... ${String(omitted)} bytes omitted ...]
${decoder.decode(tail.subarray(tailStart))}` + `
[${stream}: ${String(total)} bytes, ${String(omitted)} omitted from the middle; ${where}]
`;
}
var COMMAND_OUTPUT_LIMITS;
var init_bounded_output = __esm(() => {
  COMMAND_OUTPUT_LIMITS = { headBytes: 256 * 1024, tailBytes: 256 * 1024 };
});

// packages/pc-agent/src/daemon/supervisor.js
var require_supervisor = __commonJS(function(exports2, module2) {
  var fs = require("fs");
  var path = require("path");
  var os = require("os");
  var { spawn } = require("child_process");
  var sandbox = require("./sandbox.js");
  var { createProcReader, procStat, procEntryGone, groupHasLiveProcess } = require("./pty.js");
  var { runToExit } = require("./update.js");
  var { errorDetail } = require_log();
  var { heldModule } = require_held();
  init_bounded_output();
  var EXEC_STREAM_MAX_BYTES = 512 * 1024;
  var REQUEST_ID = /^rpc-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10}-[1-9]\d*$/;
  var STATUS_FD = 3;
  function isRequestId(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" && REQUEST_ID.test(value);
  }
  var OUTPUT_RECORD_HEADER_BYTES = 7;
  var EXEC_CAPTURE_MAX_BYTES = EXEC_STREAM_MAX_BYTES + 16 * 1024;
  function supervisionSupported(platform = process.platform) {
    return platform === "linux" || platform === "darwin";
  }
  function assertSupervisionSupported() {
    if (!supervisionSupported())
      throw new Error("pc-agent command supervision requires POSIX Linux or macOS");
  }
  function requestDirectory(root, requestId) {
    if (!isRequestId(requestId))
      throw new Error("exec request id must match rpc-<epoch>-<sequence>");
    const resolvedRoot = path.resolve(root);
    const dir = path.resolve(resolvedRoot, requestId);
    if (path.dirname(dir) !== resolvedRoot)
      throw new Error("exec request directory must be a direct child of the in-flight root");
    return dir;
  }
  async function psOutput(args) {
    const { error, stdout } = await runToExit("ps", args, { encoding: "utf8" });
    if (error !== null)
      throw error;
    return stdout;
  }
  async function processStartIdentity(pid) {
    if (process.platform === "linux") {
      const start = procStat(pid, "stat", true).startTicks;
      if (!start)
        throw new Error(`cannot read start identity for supervisor ${pid}`);
      return start;
    }
    if (process.platform === "darwin") {
      const start = (await psOutput(["-p", String(pid), "-o", "lstart="])).trim();
      if (!start)
        throw new Error(`cannot read start identity for supervisor ${pid}`);
      return start;
    }
    throw new Error("pc-agent command supervision requires POSIX Linux or macOS");
  }
  function readFieldFile(file) {
    const text = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
    return new Map(text.trimEnd().split(`
`).map((line) => {
      const separator = line.indexOf("=");
      return [line.slice(0, separator), line.slice(separator + 1)];
    }));
  }
  function readSupervisorState(dir) {
    const fields = readFieldFile(path.join(dir, "state"));
    const pid = Number(fields.get("pid"));
    const start = fields.get("start");
    const group = Number(fields.get("group"));
    const groupStart = fields.get("groupStart");
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(pid) || pid <= 0 || !start || !Number.isSafeInteger(group) || group <= 0 || !groupStart) {
      throw new Error(`invalid supervisor state in ${dir}`);
    }
    return { pid, start, group, groupStart };
  }
  async function startedAs(pid, start) {
    try {
      return await processStartIdentity(pid) === start;
    } catch (err) {
      if (procEntryGone(err) || process.platform === "darwin" && err && err.code === 1) {
        return false;
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }
  async function supervisorStartMatches(entry) {
    return await startedAs(entry.pid, entry.start) && await startedAs(entry.group, entry.groupStart);
  }
  var SIGNAL_NAME = /^SIG[A-Z0-9]+$/;
  function readTerminalResult(dir) {
    const fields = readFieldFile(path.join(dir, "result"));
    const kind = fields.get("kind");
    const exitCode = Number(fields.get("exitCode"));
    const signal = fields.get("signal") ?? null;
    if (kind !== "exited" && kind !== "cancelled" || !Number.isSafeInteger(exitCode) || signal !== null && !SIGNAL_NAME.test(signal)) {
      throw new Error(`invalid terminal result in ${dir}`);
    }
    return { kind, exitCode, signal };
  }
  function readCapturedOutput(file) {
    const descriptor = fs.openSync(file, "r");
    try {
      const bytes = Buffer.allocUnsafe(Math.min(fs.fstatSync(descriptor).size, EXEC_CAPTURE_MAX_BYTES));
      const read = fs.readSync(descriptor, bytes, 0, bytes.length, 0);
      const output = bytes.subarray(0, read).toString();
      return fs.existsSync(file + ".after-exit") ? output + `
[background output after command exit is not captured]
` : output;
    } finally {
      fs.closeSync(descriptor);
    }
  }
  var UNCHECKPOINTED_FILE = "uncheckpointed";
  function readExecResult(dir) {
    const terminal = readTerminalResult(dir);
    const stderr = readCapturedOutput(path.join(dir, "stderr"));
    const note = terminal.signal === null ? "" : `Command terminated by ${terminal.signal}.`;
    const uncheckpointed = readUncheckpointed(dir);
    const result = {
      stdout: readCapturedOutput(path.join(dir, "stdout")),
      stderr: note === "" ? stderr : `${stderr}${stderr === "" || stderr.endsWith(`
`) ? "" : `
`}${note}`,
      exitCode: terminal.exitCode
    };
    if (uncheckpointed !== null)
      result.uncheckpointed = uncheckpointed;
    return { terminal, result };
  }
  function readUncheckpointed(dir) {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, UNCHECKPOINTED_FILE), "utf8"));
    } catch (err) {
      if (err && err.code === "ENOENT")
        return null;
      throw err;
    }
  }
  var SUPERVISOR_SCRIPT = `
'use strict';
const fs = require('node:fs');
const { procStat, groupHasLiveProcess } = (${createProcReader.toString()})(fs);
const elidedOutput = (${elidedOutput.toString()});
const { execFile, spawn } = require('node:child_process');
// A spill opens where it was judged, without following a link a sandboxed command put in its path (held.js).
const { atJudged } = (${heldModule.toString()})(require);

// fd 4 is the record's \`life\`, handed over at this process's spawn: the kernel closes it however this process exits,
// and the daemon reads that close as this supervisor gone.
const [commandFile, stateFile, resultFile, stdoutFile, stderrFile, ackFile, maxText, planFile] = process.argv.slice(1);
const maxOutput = Number(maxText);
// Half kept from the start, half from the end, as core's BoundedOutput keeps them (COMMAND_OUTPUT_LIMITS).
const HEAD = Math.floor(maxOutput / 2);
const TAIL = maxOutput - HEAD;

/** The daemon that started this supervisor, by IDENTITY rather than liveness:
 * the kernel reparents an orphan, so a changed ppid is exactly "the parent is
 * gone" and carries no pid-reuse hazard. Read before anything can fail. */
const parentPid = process.ppid;
const ORPHAN_POLL_MS = 1000;

/** A child run to its exit: its stdout, or its error thrown. Never synchronous; the daemon's runToExit says why. */
function run(file, args) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = execFile(file, args, { encoding: 'utf8' }, (error, stdout) => {
      if (error) reject(error);
      else resolve(stdout);
    });
    child.stdin.end();
  });
}

function linuxStartIdentity(pid) {
  const stat = procStat(pid, 'stat', true);
  if (!stat.startTicks) throw new Error('cannot read process start identity');
  return stat.startTicks;
}

/** What the daemon reads back with the same ps; empty once the process is gone (ps exits 1). */
async function psStartIdentity(pid) {
  try {
    return (await run('ps', ['-p', String(pid), '-o', 'lstart='])).trim();
  } catch (err) {
    if (err && err.code === 1) return '';
    throw err;
  }
}

/** A start no process has: the daemon then finds the group gone, as it is once its leader is reaped. */
const REAPED_BEFORE_READ = 'reaped before its start was read';

/** This supervisor's start and its command's. The kernel answers on Linux before the event loop can reap the
 *  command; elsewhere both ps runs start in this tick, and a command reaped before its row was read has ended. */
async function startIdentities() {
  if (process.platform === 'linux') return [linuxStartIdentity(process.pid), linuxStartIdentity(child.pid)];
  const [own, group] = await Promise.all([psStartIdentity(process.pid), psStartIdentity(child.pid)]);
  if (!own) throw new Error('cannot read process start identity');
  return [own, group || REAPED_BEFORE_READ];
}

/** Startup either publishes an authoritative group or leaves no group at all. A detached child exists only
 *  after spawn, so every post-spawn failure kills and reaps that exact group rather than abandoning an
 *  unnameable command. */
function abandonStartup() {
  if (child && child.pid) {
    try { process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGKILL'); } catch (killError) {
      if (!killError || killError.code !== 'ESRCH') throw new Error('supervisor startup group cleanup', { cause: killError });
    }
  }
  process.exit(125);
}

async function publishState() {
  // First, before anything yields: on Linux the command's identity is read before the event loop can reap it.
  const [start, groupStart] = await startIdentities();
  const stateTemporary = stateFile + '.tmp.' + process.pid;
  fs.writeFileSync(
    stateTemporary,
    'pid=' + process.pid + '\\nstart=' + start + '\\ngroup=' + child.pid + '\\ngroupStart=' + groupStart + '\\n',
    { mode: 0o600 },
  );
  fs.renameSync(stateTemporary, stateFile);
}

function writeTerminalResult(kind, exitCode, signal) {
  const temporary = resultFile + '.tmp.' + process.pid;
  const named = signal ? 'signal=' + signal + '\\n' : '';
  fs.writeFileSync(temporary, 'kind=' + kind + '\\nexitCode=' + exitCode + '\\n' + named, { mode: 0o600 });
  fs.renameSync(temporary, resultFile);
}

/** One stream: the first HEAD bytes go to its file as they arrive, the last TAIL stay in a ring, every
 *  byte is counted, and once the stream outgrows both the whole of it goes to the spill file. close()
 *  writes core's elidedOutput, as BoundedOutput.finish does, so every executor reads the same.
 *  The spill is written at its host path and named by the path the command's own view gives it. That
 *  path is in the agent's own tmp, which its commands write: it is opened where it was judged, without
 *  following a link one of them put at its name or in its directory (L111 #1), and written through the
 *  descriptor it opened. */
class Capture {
  constructor(file, spill, stream) {
    this.fd = fs.openSync(file, 'w+', 0o600);
    this.spillTarget = spill || null;
    this.stream = stream;
    this.head = 0;
    this.ring = null;
    this.ringEnd = 0;
    this.ringLength = 0;
    this.total = 0;
    this.spill = null;
    this.spillFailure = null;
  }

  write(chunk) {
    this.total += chunk.length;
    // Nothing is dropped before this chunk, so the head and ring hold everything seen so far.
    if (this.spill === null && this.spillFailure === null && this.total > HEAD + TAIL) this.openSpill();
    if (this.spill !== null) this.spillWrite(chunk);
    let rest = chunk;
    if (this.head < HEAD) {
      const taken = rest.subarray(0, HEAD - this.head);
      fs.writeSync(this.fd, taken, 0, taken.length, this.head);
      this.head += taken.length;
      rest = rest.subarray(taken.length);
    }
    if (rest.length > 0 && TAIL > 0) this.keep(rest);
  }

  openSpill() {
    if (this.spillTarget === null) {
      this.spillFailure = 'no directory to save it in';
      return;
    }
    try {
      const { O_WRONLY, O_CREAT, O_TRUNC } = fs.constants;

      this.spill = atJudged({ raw: this.spillTarget.raw }, this.spillTarget.file, { createParents: true },
        (at) => at.open(O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0o600));
      const head = Buffer.alloc(this.head);
      fs.readSync(this.fd, head, 0, this.head, 0);
      this.spillWrite(head);
      this.spillWrite(this.keptTail());
    } catch (err) {
      this.fail(err);
    }
  }

  spillWrite(bytes) {
    if (this.spill === null) return;
    try {
      for (let offset = 0; offset < bytes.length;) offset += fs.writeSync(this.spill, bytes, offset);
    } catch (err) {
      this.fail(err);
    }
  }

  fail(err) {
    this.spillFailure = 'saving ' + this.spillTarget.shown + ' failed: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : String(err));
    if (this.spill !== null) fs.closeSync(this.spill);
    this.spill = null;
  }

  keep(rest) {
    this.ring = this.ring || Buffer.alloc(TAIL);
    if (rest.length >= TAIL) {
      rest.copy(this.ring, 0, rest.length - TAIL);
      this.ringEnd = 0;
      this.ringLength = TAIL;
      return;
    }
    const first = Math.min(rest.length, TAIL - this.ringEnd);
    rest.copy(this.ring, this.ringEnd, 0, first);
    rest.copy(this.ring, 0, first);
    this.ringEnd = (this.ringEnd + rest.length) % TAIL;
    this.ringLength = Math.min(TAIL, this.ringLength + rest.length);
  }

  keptTail() {
    if (this.ring === null) return Buffer.alloc(0);
    if (this.ringLength < TAIL) return this.ring.subarray(0, this.ringLength);
    return Buffer.concat([this.ring.subarray(this.ringEnd), this.ring.subarray(0, this.ringEnd)]);
  }

  close() {
    const tail = this.keptTail();
    if (this.total === this.head + tail.length) {
      fs.writeSync(this.fd, tail, 0, tail.length, this.head);
      fs.closeSync(this.fd);
      return;
    }
    const head = Buffer.alloc(this.head);
    fs.readSync(this.fd, head, 0, this.head, 0);
    if (this.spill !== null) fs.closeSync(this.spill);
    let where = 'the full ' + this.stream + ' was not saved: ' + this.spillFailure;
    if (this.spill !== null) where = 'the full ' + this.stream + ' is at ' + this.spillTarget.shown;
    const text = Buffer.from(elidedOutput({ head, tail, total: this.total, stream: this.stream, where }));
    fs.writeSync(this.fd, text, 0, text.length, 0);
    fs.ftruncateSync(this.fd, text.length);
    fs.closeSync(this.fd);
  }
}

// The daemon's output pipe on fd 3, when its hub asked to watch: each chunk goes on as a record. A
// backlog past the plan's bound drops the chunk and counts it, and a daemon that went away (EPIPE)
// ends the forwarding, so the command never waits on the daemon and the capture never sees any of it.
let live = null;
let liveBacklog = 0;
let liveDropped = 0;

function liveRecord(kind, size) {
  const header = Buffer.alloc(7);
  header[0] = kind;
  header.writeUIntBE(size, 1, 6);
  return header;
}

function forward(kind, chunk) {
  if (live === null) return;
  if (live.writableLength > liveBacklog) {
    liveDropped += chunk.length;
    return;
  }
  if (liveDropped > 0) live.write(liveRecord(0, liveDropped));
  liveDropped = 0;
  live.write(Buffer.concat([liveRecord(kind, chunk.length), chunk]));
}

// Before the result exists: the daemon answers once this pipe has closed, so the output it forwards
// reaches the hub before the result does.
function endLive() {
  if (live === null) return;
  if (liveDropped > 0) live.write(liveRecord(0, liveDropped));
  live.end();
  live = null;
}

let child;
let stdout;
let stderr;
let sandboxPid = 0;
let cancellationRequested = false;
let cancellationSignalDelivered = false;
let completed = false;

function finish(kind, exitCode, signal) {
  if (completed) return;
  completed = true;
  stdout.close();
  stderr.close();
  endLive();
  if (kind === 'cancelled') {
    writeTerminalResult(kind, exitCode);
    process.exit(0);
    return;
  }
  // The cloud may ACK as soon as result appears. Publish an open FIFO before
  // that result, otherwise its writer can create a regular file in the race.
  run('mkfifo', [ackFile]).then(() => awaitAcknowledgement(kind, exitCode, signal), () => process.exit(125));
}

function awaitAcknowledgement(kind, exitCode, signal) {
  writeTerminalResult(kind, exitCode, signal);
  const acknowledgement = fs.createReadStream(ackFile);
  // The daemon is the only writer of this FIFO, so once it is gone the wait can
  // never end and this process would hold the request directory on the machine
  // forever. Watched only HERE, not while the command runs: a running command
  // must survive a daemon restart, and the restarted daemon adopts its live
  // supervisor by start identity. Past the result there is nothing to adopt \u2014
  // the result file stays on disk, and whichever daemon reconciles it next
  // removes the directory itself.
  const orphaned = setInterval(() => {
    if (process.ppid !== parentPid) process.exit(0);
  }, ORPHAN_POLL_MS);
  acknowledgement.once('data', () => {
    clearInterval(orphaned);
    acknowledgement.destroy();
    fs.rmSync(require('node:path').dirname(stateFile), { recursive: true, force: true });
    process.exit(0);
  });
  acknowledgement.once('error', () => process.exit(125));
}

try {
  const command = fs.readFileSync(commandFile, 'utf8');
  fs.unlinkSync(commandFile);
  // The DAEMON decides how the command runs \u2014 sandbox argv, environment, cwd \u2014
  // and this process only carries it out. That keeps the policy testable
  // without spawning anything and keeps this script dumb, which matters
  // because it outlives the daemon.
  const plan = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(planFile, 'utf8'));
  fs.unlinkSync(planFile);
  // The plan carries everything BUT the command, which this process appends
  // from the file it just unlinked: the command text then lives in one place
  // on disk rather than two, and a sentinel the daemon would have to
  // interpolate into this script is not needed.
  const argv = [...plan.argv, command];
  const spill = plan.spill || {};
  stdout = new Capture(stdoutFile, spill.stdout, 'stdout');
  stderr = new Capture(stderrFile, spill.stderr, 'stderr');
  if (plan.liveBacklog > 0) {
    liveBacklog = plan.liveBacklog;
    live = fs.createWriteStream(null, { fd: 3 });
    live.on('error', () => { live = null; });
  }
  child = spawn(argv[0], argv.slice(1), {
    detached: true,
    env: plan.env,
    cwd: plan.cwd,
    // A fourth pipe when the plan asked for one: bwrap writes its
    // --json-status-fd there, and the first line carries the host pid of the
    // sandbox's pid 1. Killing THAT is deterministic \u2014 the kernel reaps every
    // process in the namespace before pid 1's exit completes \u2014 where a group
    // kill returns before the namespace has finished dying.
    stdio: plan.statusFd === ${STATUS_FD} ? ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] : ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
  });
  if (plan.statusFd === ${STATUS_FD} && child.stdio[${STATUS_FD}]) {
    let statusText = '';
    child.stdio[${STATUS_FD}].on('data', (chunk) => {
      // Scanned whole rather than split by line: this script is a template in
      // the daemon's own source, so a newline escape here lands as a REAL
      // newline inside a string literal and the supervisor stops parsing \u2014
      // which is exactly how it failed, silently, with exit 1.
      statusText += chunk.toString();
      const match = /"child-pid"\\s*:\\s*(\\d+)/.exec(statusText);
      if (match) sandboxPid = Number(match[1]);
    });
  }
  process.on('SIGUSR1', () => {
    if (!child || completed || cancellationRequested) return;
    cancellationRequested = true;
    try {
      // The namespace's pid 1 when there is one, its process group otherwise.
      // Both reach every descendant; only the first is synchronous.
      if (sandboxPid > 0) process.kill(sandboxPid, 'SIGKILL');
      else process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGKILL');
      cancellationSignalDelivered = true;
    } catch (err) {
      if (!err || err.code !== 'ESRCH') finish('exited', 125);
    }
  });
  child.stdout.on('data', (chunk) => {
    if (completed) return;
    stdout.write(chunk);
    forward(1, chunk);
  });
  child.stderr.on('data', (chunk) => {
    if (completed) return;
    stderr.write(chunk);
    forward(2, chunk);
  });
} catch (err) {
  abandonStartup();
}

publishState().catch(abandonStartup);



child.once('exit', (code, signal) => {
  // A cancellation is only an end the kill caused. A command can exit on its own after the cancel arrives and before
  // this supervisor reaps it, and a signal to that exited, unreaped group still reports delivered; a sandbox's
  // launcher reports its killed namespace as 128 + SIGKILL.
  const killed = signal === 'SIGKILL' || (sandboxPid > 0 && code === 137);
  const finishAfterDrain = () => {
    if (cancellationRequested && cancellationSignalDelivered && killed) {
      // This confirms only the owned process group. A command can use setsid
      // to escape that group; same-uid supervision cannot honestly claim it
      // terminated such a detached descendant.
      groupHasLiveProcess(child.pid, (args) => run('ps', args)).then(
        (groupAlive) => finish(groupAlive ? 'exited' : 'cancelled', groupAlive ? 125 : 137),
        () => finish('exited', 125),
      );
      return;
    }
    // A signal death is 128 plus that signal's number on this platform (SIGBUS
    // is 7 on Linux and 10 on macOS). Node reports exactly one of code and
    // signal; an end with neither is this supervisor's own failure.
    if (typeof code === 'number') finish('exited', code);
    else if (signal) finish('exited', 128 + (require('node:os').constants.signals[signal] || 0), signal);
    else finish('exited', 125);
  };
  setTimeout(() => {
    // A background descendant can retain the inherited pipes forever. At this
    // established drain boundary, closing them makes the command terminal; mark
    if (child.stdout.readable) { fs.writeFileSync(stdoutFile + '.after-exit', '1'); child.stdout.destroy(); }
    if (child.stderr.readable) { fs.writeFileSync(stderrFile + '.after-exit', '1'); child.stderr.destroy(); }
    finishAfterDrain();
  }, 250);
});
`;
  function waitForPath(file, exists, signal) {
    if (fs.existsSync(file) === exists)
      return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const directory = path.dirname(file);
      const name = path.basename(file);
      let watcher;
      let settled = false;
      const finish = (error) => {
        if (settled)
          return;
        settled = true;
        if (watcher)
          watcher.close();
        signal?.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
        if (error)
          reject(error);
        else
          resolve();
      };
      const check = (_event, changed) => {
        if (changed !== null && String(changed) !== name)
          return;
        if (fs.existsSync(file) === exists)
          finish();
      };
      const onAbort = () => finish(signal.reason instanceof Error ? signal.reason : new Error("file watch aborted"));
      try {
        watcher = fs.watch(directory, check);
        watcher.once("error", finish);
        signal?.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
      } catch (err) {
        finish(err);
        return;
      }
      if (fs.existsSync(file) === exists)
        finish();
    });
  }
  function waitForFile(file, signal) {
    return waitForPath(file, true, signal);
  }
  async function supervisorExit(dir, signal) {
    let fd;
    try {
      fd = fs.openSync(path.join(dir, "life"), fs.constants.O_RDONLY | fs.constants.O_NONBLOCK);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err && err.code === "ENOENT")
        return;
      throw err;
    }
    try {
      if (!lifeHeld(fd))
        return;
      const reader = Bun.file(fd).stream().getReader();
      let cancelled = Promise.resolve();
      const cancel = () => {
        cancelled = reader.cancel();
      };
      signal.addEventListener("abort", cancel, { once: true });
      try {
        while (!(await reader.read()).done)
          ;
      } finally {
        signal.removeEventListener("abort", cancel);
        await cancelled;
      }
    } finally {
      fs.closeSync(fd);
    }
  }
  function lifeHeld(fd) {
    try {
      return fs.readSync(fd, Buffer.alloc(1)) !== 0;
    } catch (err) {
      if (err && err.code === "EAGAIN")
        return true;
      throw err;
    }
  }
  async function resultWritten(entry, requestId) {
    const resultFile = path.join(entry.dir, "result");
    const settled = new AbortController;
    const written = waitForFile(resultFile, settled.signal);
    const exited = supervisorExit(entry.dir, settled.signal);
    try {
      await Promise.race([written, exited]);
    } finally {
      settled.abort();
      await Promise.allSettled([written, exited]);
    }
    resultRecorded(entry, requestId);
  }
  async function supervisorStateWritten(dir) {
    const stateFile = path.join(dir, "state");
    if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, "life")))
      throw new Error(`no supervisor holds ${dir}`);
    const settled = new AbortController;
    const written = waitForFile(stateFile, settled.signal);
    const exited = supervisorExit(dir, settled.signal);
    try {
      await Promise.race([written, exited]);
    } finally {
      settled.abort();
      await Promise.allSettled([written, exited]);
    }
    if (!fs.existsSync(stateFile))
      throw new Error(`the supervisor of ${dir} exited before publishing its state`);
  }
  function resultRecorded(entry, requestId) {
    if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(entry.dir, "result"))) {
      throw new Error(`the supervisor of ${requestId} (pid ${entry.pid}) exited without recording the command's result, ` + `so its outcome is unknown; the command may still be running in process group ${entry.group}`);
    }
  }
  async function stopSupervisor(entry, requestId) {
    try {
      process.kill(entry.pid, "SIGUSR1");
    } catch (err) {
      if (!err || err.code !== "ESRCH")
        throw err;
      resultRecorded(entry, requestId);
      return;
    }
    await resultWritten(entry, requestId);
  }
  async function handOver(dir) {
    const settled = new AbortController;
    const exited = supervisorExit(dir, settled.signal);
    const removed = writeAcknowledgement(dir, settled.signal).then(() => waitForDirectoryRemoval(dir, settled.signal));
    try {
      await Promise.race([removed, exited]);
    } finally {
      settled.abort();
      await Promise.allSettled([removed, exited]);
    }
  }
  function waitForDirectoryRemoval(dir, signal) {
    return waitForPath(dir, false, signal);
  }
  function writeAcknowledgement(dir, signal) {
    const ack = path.join(dir, "ack");
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const writer = spawn("/bin/sh", ["-c", 'printf 1 > "$1"', "kinu-ack", ack], { stdio: "ignore", signal });
      writer.once("error", reject);
      writer.once("exit", (code, killedBy) => {
        if (code === 0)
          resolve();
        else
          reject(new Error(`supervisor acknowledgement writer exited with ${killedBy ?? code}`));
      });
    });
  }
  function removeRequestDirectory(dir) {
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
  function createInFlight(root, isStarting, log) {
    const entries = new Map;
    function entryFor(requestId) {
      const existing = entries.get(requestId);
      if (existing)
        return existing;
      const dir = requestDirectory(root, requestId);
      if (!fs.existsSync(dir))
        return;
      const state = readSupervisorState(dir);
      const entry = { dir, ...state };
      entries.set(requestId, entry);
      return entry;
    }
    async function loadEntry(requestId) {
      const known = entries.get(requestId);
      if (known)
        return known;
      const dir = requestDirectory(root, requestId);
      if (!fs.existsSync(dir))
        return;
      await waitForFile(path.join(dir, "state"));
      return entryFor(requestId);
    }
    async function reconcile() {
      if (!fs.existsSync(root))
        return [];
      const recovered = [];
      for (const directory of fs.readdirSync(root, { withFileTypes: true })) {
        if (!directory.isDirectory() || isStarting(directory.name))
          continue;
        const dir = path.join(root, directory.name);
        try {
          requestDirectory(root, directory.name);
          if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, "state")))
            await supervisorStateWritten(dir);
          const state = readSupervisorState(dir);
          const supervising = await startedAs(state.pid, state.start);
          const terminal = fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, "result"));
          if (!terminal && !supervising) {
            removeRequestDirectory(dir);
            continue;
          }
          entries.set(directory.name, { dir, ...state });
          recovered.push({ requestId: directory.name, terminal });
        } catch (err) {
          log("Removing unusable in-flight command record", dir, errorDetail(err));
          removeRequestDirectory(dir);
        }
      }
      return recovered;
    }
    function register(requestId, dir) {
      entries.set(requestId, { dir, ...readSupervisorState(dir) });
    }
    async function cancel(requestId) {
      if (!isRequestId(requestId))
        return { requestId, cancelled: "unknown" };
      let entry;
      try {
        entry = await loadEntry(requestId);
      } catch (err) {
        throw new Error(`cannot validate supervisor for ${requestId}: ${errorDetail(err)}`, { cause: err });
      }
      if (!entry || fs.existsSync(path.join(entry.dir, "result"))) {
        return { requestId, cancelled: "unknown" };
      }
      if (!await supervisorStartMatches(entry)) {
        throw new Error(`cannot terminate ${requestId}: supervisor identity no longer matches`);
      }
      await stopSupervisor(entry, requestId);
      const terminal = readTerminalResult(entry.dir);
      if (terminal.kind !== "cancelled") {
        throw new Error(`cannot terminate ${requestId}: supervisor exited without a confirmed group termination`);
      }
      if (await groupHasLiveProcess(entry.group, psOutput)) {
        throw new Error(`cannot terminate ${requestId}: owned process group death is unconfirmed`);
      }
      return { requestId, cancelled: "terminated" };
    }
    async function result(requestId) {
      const entry = await loadEntry(requestId);
      if (!entry)
        return;
      await resultWritten(entry, requestId);
      return { entry, ...readExecResult(entry.dir) };
    }
    async function acknowledge(requestId) {
      const entry = await loadEntry(requestId);
      if (!entry)
        return { requestId, acknowledged: true };
      const terminal = readTerminalResult(entry.dir);
      if (terminal.kind === "exited" && await startedAs(entry.pid, entry.start))
        await handOver(entry.dir);
      removeRequestDirectory(entry.dir);
      entries.delete(requestId);
      return { requestId, acknowledged: true };
    }
    async function terminateUnanswered() {
      await reconcile();
      const terminations = [];
      for (const [requestId, entry] of entries) {
        let reportTerminationFailure = function(error) {
          log("Could not terminate abandoned command", requestId, error);
        };
        if (fs.existsSync(path.join(entry.dir, "result")))
          continue;
        const terminated = cancel(requestId);
        terminated.catch(reportTerminationFailure);
        terminations.push({ requestId, terminated });
      }
      return terminations;
    }
    function reportReconcileFailure(error) {
      log("Could not reconcile in-flight commands under", root, errorDetail(error));
    }
    const ready = reconcile();
    ready.catch(reportReconcileFailure);
    return {
      ready,
      register,
      cancel,
      result,
      acknowledge,
      reconcile,
      terminateUnanswered,
      size() {
        return entries.size;
      }
    };
  }
  async function startSupervisor({ root, env, requestId }, command, plan, { uncheckpointed, outputWindow }) {
    assertSupervisionSupported();
    const dir = requestDirectory(root, requestId);
    fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true, mode: 448 });
    fs.chmodSync(root, 448);
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { mode: 448 });
    fs.chmodSync(dir, 448);
    const commandFile = path.join(dir, "command");
    fs.writeFileSync(commandFile, command, { encoding: "utf8", mode: 384, flag: "wx" });
    const planFile = path.join(dir, "plan.json");
    fs.writeFileSync(planFile, JSON.stringify({
      argv: plan.argv.slice(0, -1),
      env: plan.env,
      statusFd: plan.statusFd,
      cwd: plan.spawnCwd,
      spill: outputSpill(plan, requestId),
      liveBacklog: outputWindow
    }), { encoding: "utf8", mode: 384, flag: "wx" });
    if (uncheckpointed !== null) {
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, UNCHECKPOINTED_FILE), JSON.stringify(uncheckpointed), { encoding: "utf8", mode: 384, flag: "wx" });
    }
    const lifeFile = path.join(dir, "life");
    const made = await runToExit("mkfifo", [lifeFile]);
    if (made.error)
      throw new Error(`could not create ${lifeFile}: ${errorDetail(made.error)}`, { cause: made.error });
    const life = fs.openSync(lifeFile, "r+");
    let child;
    try {
      child = spawn(process.execPath, [
        "-e",
        SUPERVISOR_SCRIPT,
        commandFile,
        path.join(dir, "state"),
        path.join(dir, "result"),
        path.join(dir, "stdout"),
        path.join(dir, "stderr"),
        path.join(dir, "ack"),
        String(EXEC_STREAM_MAX_BYTES),
        planFile
      ], { detached: true, env, stdio: ["ignore", "ignore", "ignore", outputWindow > 0 ? "pipe" : "ignore", life] });
    } finally {
      fs.closeSync(life);
    }
    child.unref();
    return { child, dir };
  }
  function outputSpill(plan, requestId) {
    const dir = path.join(plan.view.raw ? os.tmpdir() : plan.view.agentTmp, "kinu-tool-output");
    const at = (stream) => {
      const file = path.join(dir, `device-${requestId}.${stream}.log`);
      return { file, shown: plan.view.raw ? file : plan.view.insidePath(file), raw: plan.view.raw === true };
    };
    return { stdout: at("stdout"), stderr: at("stderr") };
  }
  function waitForSupervisorState(dir, child) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const controller = new AbortController;
      let settled = false;
      const finish = (error) => {
        if (settled)
          return;
        settled = true;
        child.off("error", onError);
        child.off("exit", onExit);
        controller.abort(error);
        if (error)
          reject(error);
        else
          resolve();
      };
      const onError = (err) => finish(err);
      const onExit = (code, signal) => {
        if (fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, "state")))
          finish();
        else
          finish(new Error(`supervisor exited before publishing state (${signal ?? code ?? 0})`));
      };
      child.once("error", onError);
      child.once("exit", onExit);
      function finishWithError(error) {
        if (!settled)
          finish(error);
      }
      waitForFile(path.join(dir, "state"), controller.signal).then(() => finish(), finishWithError);
    });
  }
  function readOutputRecords(pipe, { bytes, lost }) {
    let header = Buffer.alloc(0);
    let source = 0;
    let remaining = 0;
    pipe.on("data", (data) => {
      for (let at = 0;at < data.length; ) {
        if (remaining > 0) {
          const end = Math.min(data.length, at + remaining);
          bytes(source === 1 ? "stdout" : "stderr", data.subarray(at, end));
          remaining -= end - at;
          at = end;
          continue;
        }
        const end = Math.min(data.length, at + OUTPUT_RECORD_HEADER_BYTES - header.length);
        header = Buffer.concat([header, data.subarray(at, end)]);
        at = end;
        if (header.length < OUTPUT_RECORD_HEADER_BYTES)
          continue;
        source = header[0];
        const size = header.readUIntBE(1, 6);
        header = Buffer.alloc(0);
        if (source === 0)
          lost(size);
        else
          remaining = size;
      }
    });
  }
  function createSupervision({ root, isStarting = () => false, log = () => {} }) {
    const { register, ...registry } = createInFlight(root, isStarting, log);
    const env = sandbox.sandboxEnvironment(process.env, {});
    return {
      ...registry,
      start: (requestId, command, plan, options) => startSupervisor({ root, env, requestId }, command, plan, options),
      async adopt(requestId, { dir, child }) {
        await waitForSupervisorState(dir, child);
        register(requestId, dir);
      },
      joining(requestId) {
        const dir = requestDirectory(root, requestId);
        return fs.existsSync(dir) ? waitForFile(path.join(dir, "state")) : null;
      }
    };
  }
  module2.exports = {
    STATUS_FD,
    createSupervision,
    readOutputRecords,
    supervisionSupported,
    assertSupervisionSupported,
    requestDirectory,
    processStartIdentity,
    waitForFile,
    waitForSupervisorState,
    stopSupervisor
  };
});

// packages/cli-backend/src/machine-pidfile.ts
function codeOf(err) {
  return "code" in err && (typeof err.code === "string" || typeof err.code === "number") ? String(err.code) : null;
}
function failedWith(caught, ...codes) {
  const code = codeOf(caught);
  return code !== null && codes.includes(code);
}
function pidIn(text) {
  const pid = Number(text.trim());
  return Number.isInteger(pid) && pid > 0 ? pid : null;
}
function readMachinePid(pidPath) {
  try {
    return pidIn(import_node_fs.readFileSync(pidPath, "utf8"));
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof Error && failedWith(err, "ENOENT"))
      return null;
    throw new Error(`reading the device daemon pidfile at ${pidPath}`, { cause: err });
  }
}
function machineProcessAlive(pid) {
  try {
    process.kill(pid, 0);
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof Error && failedWith(err, "ESRCH"))
      return false;
    if (err instanceof Error && failedWith(err, "EPERM"))
      return true;
    throw new Error(`checking whether pid ${String(pid)} is running`, { cause: err });
  }
}
function procRead(pid, file) {
  try {
    return import_node_fs.readFileSync(`/proc/${String(pid)}/${file}`, "utf8");
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof Error && failedWith(err, "ENOENT", "ESRCH"))
      return null;
    throw err;
  }
}
function psCommand(pid) {
  const { promise, resolve, reject } = Promise.withResolvers();
  import_node_child_process.execFile("ps", ["-p", String(pid), "-o", "command="], { encoding: "utf8" }, (err, stdout) => {
    if (err)
      reject(err);
    else
      resolve(stdout);
  });
  return promise;
}
async function runsMachineDaemon(pid, daemonPath) {
  const named = (args) => args.some((arg) => arg === daemonPath || import_node_path.basename(arg) === import_node_path.basename(daemonPath));
  try {
    if (process.platform === "linux") {
      const args = procRead(pid, "cmdline");
      if (args === null)
        return false;
      if (args !== "")
        return named(args.split("\x00"));
      const stat = procRead(pid, "stat") ?? "";
      const state = stat.slice(stat.lastIndexOf(")") + 2, stat.lastIndexOf(")") + 3);
      return state !== "" && state !== "Z";
    }
    if (process.platform === "darwin")
      return named((await psCommand(pid)).trim().split(/\s+/u));
    return false;
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof Error && failedWith(err, "EACCES", "EPERM"))
      return false;
    if (process.platform === "darwin" && err instanceof Error && failedWith(err, PS_NO_SUCH_PROCESS))
      return false;
    throw new Error(`checking whether pid ${String(pid)} runs the device daemon`, { cause: err });
  }
}
function publishMachinePid(pidPath, pid) {
  const claims = `${pidPath}.claims`;
  const claim = import_node_path.join(claims, `${String(pid)}-${import_node_crypto.randomBytes(8).toString("hex")}`);
  try {
    import_node_fs.mkdirSync(claims, { recursive: true, mode: 448 });
    const descriptor = import_node_fs.openSync(claim, "wx", 384);
    try {
      import_node_fs.writeFileSync(descriptor, `${String(pid)}
`);
      import_node_fs.fsyncSync(descriptor);
    } finally {
      import_node_fs.closeSync(descriptor);
    }
    try {
      import_node_fs.linkSync(claim, pidPath);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof Error && failedWith(err, "EEXIST"))
        return false;
      throw err;
    }
    syncDirectory(import_node_path.dirname(pidPath));
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error(`writing the device daemon pidfile at ${pidPath}`, { cause: err });
  } finally {
    import_node_fs.rmSync(claim, { force: true });
  }
}
function syncDirectory(directory) {
  if (process.platform === "win32")
    return;
  const descriptor = import_node_fs.openSync(directory, "r");
  try {
    import_node_fs.fsyncSync(descriptor);
  } finally {
    import_node_fs.closeSync(descriptor);
  }
}
function removeMachinePid(pidPath, pid) {
  const claims = `${pidPath}.claims`;
  const aside = import_node_path.join(claims, `aside-${String(process.pid)}-${import_node_crypto.randomBytes(8).toString("hex")}`);
  try {
    import_node_fs.mkdirSync(claims, { recursive: true, mode: 448 });
    try {
      import_node_fs.renameSync(pidPath, aside);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof Error && failedWith(err, "ENOENT"))
        return;
      throw err;
    }
    if (pidIn(import_node_fs.readFileSync(aside, "utf8")) !== pid) {
      try {
        import_node_fs.linkSync(aside, pidPath);
      } catch (err) {
        if (!(err instanceof Error && failedWith(err, "EEXIST")))
          throw err;
      }
    }
    import_node_fs.rmSync(aside, { force: true });
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error(`removing the device daemon pidfile at ${pidPath}`, { cause: err });
  }
}
async function claimMachine(pidPath, pid, daemonPath, takesOver = () => false) {
  for (let attempt = 0;attempt < 2; attempt += 1) {
    if (publishMachinePid(pidPath, pid))
      return { held: true, holder: pid };
    const holder = readMachinePid(pidPath);
    if (holder === pid)
      return { held: true, holder: pid };
    if (holder !== null && machineProcessAlive(holder) && await runsMachineDaemon(holder, daemonPath) && !takesOver(holder)) {
      return { held: false, holder };
    }
    removeMachinePid(pidPath, holder);
  }
  return { held: false, holder: readMachinePid(pidPath) };
}
var import_node_child_process, import_node_crypto, import_node_fs, import_node_path, PS_NO_SUCH_PROCESS = "1";
var init_machine_pidfile = __esm(() => {
  import_node_child_process = require("child_process");
  import_node_crypto = require("crypto");
  import_node_fs = require("fs");
  import_node_path = require("path");
});

// packages/core/src/cli/bun-runtime.ts
var exports_bun_runtime = {};
__export(exports_bun_runtime, {
  KINU_BUN_VERSION: () => KINU_BUN_VERSION,
  approvedBun: () => approvedBun,
  bunResolutionShell: () => bunResolutionShell
});
function bunVersionKey(version) {
  const parts = /^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)/.exec(version);
  if (!parts)
    throw new Error(`Not a major.minor.patch version: ${version}`);
  return Number(parts[1]) * 1e6 + Number(parts[2]) * 1000 + Number(parts[3]);
}
function approvedBun(version) {
  return /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+/.test(version) && bunVersionKey(version) >= bunVersionKey(KINU_BUN_VERSION);
}
function bunResolutionShell() {
  return `KINU_BUN_VERSION="${KINU_BUN_VERSION}"
KINU_BUN_MIN_KEY=${bunVersionKey(KINU_BUN_VERSION)}
KINU_MANAGED_BUN="$KINU_HOME/${KINU_MANAGED_BUN_SUBPATH}"
KINU_BUN=""

# A candidate's own version as one comparable integer. A version that is not
# three dot-separated numbers is not comparable, so it does not qualify.
kinu_bun_key() {
  case "$1" in *.*.*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  kb_major="\${1%%.*}"
  kb_rest="\${1#*.}"
  kb_minor="\${kb_rest%%.*}"
  kb_patch="\${kb_rest#*.}"
  kb_patch="\${kb_patch%%[!0-9]*}"
  case "$kb_major$kb_minor$kb_patch" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
  printf '%s' "$(( kb_major * 1000000 + kb_minor * 1000 + kb_patch ))"
}

# An ABSOLUTE path or nothing: an executable test on a bare name resolves
# against the working directory, so a file named bun sitting wherever the user
# happened to run this would qualify as the runtime.
kinu_bun_compatible() {
  [ -n "\${1:-}" ] || return 1
  case "$1" in /*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  [ -x "$1" ] || return 1
  kc_version="$("$1" --version 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  kc_key="$(kinu_bun_key "$kc_version")" || return 1
  [ "$kc_key" -ge "$KINU_BUN_MIN_KEY" ]
}

# Kinu's managed Bun first. It is an absolute path the installer controls, so
# the launcher resolves the binary the installer verified whatever PATH the
# user's next shell has: a PATH disagreement is what prints "Kinu CLI is ready."
# and then "Bun is required."
kinu_resolve_bun() {
  KINU_BUN=""
  for kr_candidate in "$KINU_MANAGED_BUN" "$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null || true)" "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun"; do
    if kinu_bun_compatible "$kr_candidate"; then
      KINU_BUN="$kr_candidate"
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

# The one runtime. An existing compatible Bun is used as it is; otherwise the
# approved Bun is installed once, under $KINU_HOME, where kinu_resolve_bun finds
# it whatever PATH a later shell has. Runs under set -e and pipefail, so a
# download that fails stops here with its own error; the caller defines die.
provide_bun() {
  if kinu_resolve_bun; then return 0; fi
  if [ "\${KINU_INSTALL_BUN:-1}" = "0" ]; then
    die "Bun $KINU_BUN_VERSION or newer is required. Install Bun, or rerun without KINU_INSTALL_BUN=0."
  fi
  echo "Installing Bun $KINU_BUN_VERSION..." >&2
  mkdir -p "$KINU_HOME/runtime"
  curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | BUN_INSTALL="$KINU_HOME/runtime" bash -s "bun-v$KINU_BUN_VERSION" >&2
  kinu_resolve_bun || die "Bun $KINU_BUN_VERSION was installed to $KINU_MANAGED_BUN but did not run."
}
`;
}
var KINU_BUN_VERSION = "1.4.3", KINU_MANAGED_BUN_SUBPATH = "runtime/bin/bun";

// packages/core/src/utils/base64.ts
function base64ToBytes(b64) {
  const bin = atob(b64);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (let i = 0;i < bin.length; i++)
    bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return bytes;
}

// packages/core/src/utils/text.ts
function compareCodeUnits(a, b) {
  if (a < b)
    return -1;
  return a > b ? 1 : 0;
}
var XML_ENTITIES, HTML_ENTITIES;
var init_text = __esm(() => {
  XML_ENTITIES = new Map([["amp", "&"], ["lt", "<"], ["gt", ">"], ["quot", '"'], ["apos", "'"]]);
  HTML_ENTITIES = new Map([...XML_ENTITIES, ["nbsp", " "]]);
});

// packages/core/src/http/release-message.ts
var exports_release_message = {};
__export(exports_release_message, {
  RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY: () => RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY,
  RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_ENV: () => RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_ENV,
  verifyRelease: () => verifyRelease
});
function releaseMessage(version, checksums) {
  const lines = Object.entries(checksums).sort(([a], [b]) => compareCodeUnits(a, b)).map(([path, sha256]) => `${path} ${sha256.toLowerCase()}`);
  return new TextEncoder().encode([MESSAGE_PREFIX, version, ...lines, ""].join(`
`));
}
async function verifyRelease(release, publicKeyHex) {
  if (!PUBLIC_KEY_HEX.test(publicKeyHex) || !SIGNATURE_BASE64.test(release.signature))
    return false;
  const publicKey = Uint8Array.from(publicKeyHex.match(/../gu) ?? [], (pair) => Number.parseInt(pair, 16));
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw", publicKey, { name: "Ed25519" }, false, ["verify"]);
  return await crypto.subtle.verify("Ed25519", key, base64ToBytes(release.signature), releaseMessage(release.version, release.checksums));
}
var RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY = "232098b9f5cc9b300b903bb9f3347ecb2b62115b2711438ab7fab12d30bfbaef", RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_ENV = "KINU_RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY", MESSAGE_PREFIX = "kinu-release-v1", PUBLIC_KEY_HEX, SIGNATURE_BASE64;
var init_release_message = __esm(() => {
  init_text();
  PUBLIC_KEY_HEX = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/iu;
  SIGNATURE_BASE64 = /^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{86}==$/u;
});

// packages/core/src/cli/command-env.ts
var exports_command_env = {};
__export(exports_command_env, {
  DAEMON_PREDECESSOR_ENV: () => DAEMON_PREDECESSOR_ENV,
  fromDotenv: () => fromDotenv,
  launchDotenv: () => launchDotenv,
  launchDotenvFiles: () => launchDotenvFiles,
  unsandboxedCommandEnvironment: () => unsandboxedCommandEnvironment
});
function launchDotenvFiles(nodeEnv) {
  const mode = nodeEnv === undefined || nodeEnv === "" ? "development" : nodeEnv;
  return [".env", `.env.${mode}`, ...mode === "test" ? [] : [".env.local"], `.env.${mode}.local`, ".dev.vars"];
}
function launchDotenv(files) {
  const supplied = new Map;
  for (const file of files) {
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(file))
      if (value !== undefined)
        supplied.set(name, (supplied.get(name) ?? new Set).add(value));
  }
  return supplied;
}
function fromDotenv(dotenv, name, value) {
  return dotenv.get(name)?.has(value) === true;
}
function unsandboxedCommandEnvironment(source, dotenv) {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(source).flatMap(([name, value]) => value === undefined || WITHHELD_COMMAND_ENV.has(name) || fromDotenv(dotenv, name, value) ? [] : [[name, value]]));
}
var PROVIDER_KEY_ENV, SESSION_CREDENTIAL_ENV, DAEMON_PREDECESSOR_ENV = "KINU_DAEMON_PREDECESSOR", WITHHELD_COMMAND_ENV;
var init_command_env = __esm(() => {
  init_release_message();
  PROVIDER_KEY_ENV = {
    openaiApiKey: "OPENAI_API_KEY",
    anthropicApiKey: "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
    openrouterApiKey: "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"
  };
  SESSION_CREDENTIAL_ENV = { token: "KINU_TOKEN", auth: "KINU_AUTH", gatewayAuth: "AI_GATEWAY_AUTH" };
  WITHHELD_COMMAND_ENV = new Set([
    ...Object.values(PROVIDER_KEY_ENV),
    ...Object.values(SESSION_CREDENTIAL_ENV),
    RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_ENV,
    DAEMON_PREDECESSOR_ENV
  ]);
});

// packages/core/src/checkpoints/format.ts
var exports_format = {};
__export(exports_format, {
  CHECKPOINTS_UNAVAILABLE_NO_GIT: () => CHECKPOINTS_UNAVAILABLE_NO_GIT,
  CHECKPOINT_EXCLUDES: () => CHECKPOINT_EXCLUDES,
  CHECKPOINT_REF_PREFIX: () => CHECKPOINT_REF_PREFIX,
  CHECKPOINT_WORKDIR_MARKER: () => CHECKPOINT_WORKDIR_MARKER,
  DEFAULT_CHECKPOINT_KEEP: () => DEFAULT_CHECKPOINT_KEEP,
  checkpointReason: () => checkpointReason,
  checkpointRefTimestampMs: () => checkpointRefTimestampMs,
  checkpointSubject: () => checkpointSubject,
  parseCheckpointSubject: () => parseCheckpointSubject,
  stagingOutcome: () => stagingOutcome
});
function checkpointSubject(meta, reason) {
  const clean = (field) => {
    const spaced = field.replace(/[\r\n|]/g, " ").trim();
    return spaced === "" ? "-" : spaced;
  };
  return `turn=${clean(meta?.turnId ?? "-")} session=${clean(meta?.sessionId ?? "-")} ${clean(reason)}`;
}
function parseCheckpointSubject(subject) {
  const m = /^turn=(\S+) session=(\S+) (.*)$/.exec(subject);
  if (!m)
    return { turnId: null, sessionId: null, reason: subject };
  const turn = m[1];
  const session = m[2];
  const reason = m[3];
  if (turn === undefined || session === undefined || reason === undefined) {
    return { turnId: null, sessionId: null, reason: subject };
  }
  return {
    turnId: turn === "-" ? null : turn,
    sessionId: session === "-" ? null : session,
    reason
  };
}
function diagnoseStaging(stderr) {
  const lines = stderr.split(`
`).map((line) => line.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const unreadable = new Set;
  for (const line of lines) {
    const denied = UNREADABLE_DIR.exec(line) ?? UNREADABLE_FILE.exec(line);
    const file = denied?.[1];
    if (file !== undefined)
      unreadable.add(file);
  }
  return {
    unreadable: [...unreadable].sort((left, right) => left < right ? -1 : 1),
    unexplained: lines.filter((line) => !isDenial(line, unreadable))
  };
}
function stagingOutcome(code, stderr) {
  if (code === null)
    return { failure: "checkpoint staging failed: git add did not finish" };
  const diagnosis = diagnoseStaging(stderr);
  if (diagnosis.unexplained.length > 0 || code !== 0 && diagnosis.unreadable.length === 0) {
    return { failure: `checkpoint staging failed: ${stderr.trim()}` };
  }
  return { unreadable: diagnosis.unreadable };
}
function isDenial(line, unreadable) {
  if (UNREADABLE_DIR.test(line) || UNREADABLE_FILE.test(line))
    return true;
  const unindexed = UNINDEXED_FILE.exec(line);
  if (unindexed) {
    const file = unindexed[1];
    return file !== undefined && unreadable.has(file);
  }
  return ADD_FAILED.test(line) && unreadable.size > 0;
}
function checkpointReason(reason, unreadable) {
  if (unreadable.length === 0)
    return reason;
  const shown = unreadable.slice(0, REASON_UNREADABLE_LIMIT);
  const rest = unreadable.length - shown.length;
  const more = rest > 0 ? ` +${String(rest)} more` : "";
  return `${reason} [skipped ${String(unreadable.length)} unreadable: ${shown.join(" ")}${more}]`;
}
function checkpointRefTimestampMs(ref) {
  const m = /(\d{13})-[0-9a-z]+$/.exec(ref);
  const stamp = m?.[1];
  return stamp === undefined ? 0 : Number(stamp);
}
var DEFAULT_CHECKPOINT_KEEP = 50, CHECKPOINTS_UNAVAILABLE_NO_GIT = "checkpoints unavailable: git not found", CHECKPOINT_REF_PREFIX = "refs/kinu", CHECKPOINT_WORKDIR_MARKER = "KINU_WORKDIR", CHECKPOINT_EXCLUDES, UNREADABLE_DIR, UNREADABLE_FILE, UNINDEXED_FILE, ADD_FAILED, REASON_UNREADABLE_LIMIT = 3;
var init_format = __esm(() => {
  CHECKPOINT_EXCLUDES = [
    ".git/",
    ".hg/",
    ".svn/",
    "node_modules/",
    ".venv/",
    "venv/",
    "__pycache__/",
    "*.pyc",
    "dist/",
    "build/",
    "target/",
    "out/",
    ".next/",
    ".nuxt/",
    ".cache/",
    ".pytest_cache/",
    ".mypy_cache/",
    ".ruff_cache/",
    "coverage/",
    ".DS_Store",
    "Thumbs.db",
    "*.log"
  ];
  UNREADABLE_DIR = /^warning: could not open directory '(.+?)\/?': Permission denied$/;
  UNREADABLE_FILE = /^error: open\("(.+)"\): Permission denied$/;
  UNINDEXED_FILE = /^error: unable to index file '(.+?)'$/;
  ADD_FAILED = /^fatal: adding files failed$/;
});

// packages/core/src/checkpoints/engine.ts
function failed(message) {
  return new Error(message);
}
function causeText(failure) {
  const links = [failure.message];
  for (let at = failure.cause;at instanceof Error; at = at.cause)
    links.push(at.message);
  return links.join(": ");
}
function restoreKindOf(status) {
  if (status === "A")
    return "create";
  return status === "D" ? "delete" : "modify";
}
function createCheckpointEngine(host, options) {
  const { fs: disk, path: paths } = host;
  const keep = Math.max(1, options.keep);
  const unsnapshottable = new Set([host.tmpdir, "/tmp", "/var/tmp"].map((dir) => paths.resolve(dir)));
  let gitAvailable = null;
  let refSeq = 0;
  const turnDone = new Map;
  const isolatedEnv = () => {
    const env = {};
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(host.env)) {
      if (value !== undefined && !name.startsWith("GIT_"))
        env[name] = value;
    }
    env.GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL = host.devNull;
    env.GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM = host.devNull;
    env.GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM = "1";
    env.GIT_AUTHOR_NAME = "Kinu Checkpoint";
    env.GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL = "checkpoints@kinu.local";
    env.GIT_COMMITTER_NAME = "Kinu Checkpoint";
    env.GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL = "checkpoints@kinu.local";
    env.GIT_CONFIG_COUNT = "2";
    env.GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 = "core.hooksPath";
    env.GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 = host.devNull;
    env.GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1 = "core.fsmonitor";
    env.GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1 = "false";
    env.LC_ALL = "C";
    return env;
  };
  const storeEnv = (gitDir, workdir) => ({ ...isolatedEnv(), GIT_DIR: gitDir, GIT_WORK_TREE: workdir });
  const storeOnly = (gitDir) => ({ cwd: gitDir, env: { ...isolatedEnv(), GIT_DIR: gitDir }, confine: null, writesStore: true });
  const inTree = (gitDir, workdir, confine, writesStore) => ({
    cwd: workdir,
    env: storeEnv(gitDir, workdir),
    confine,
    writesStore
  });
  const outside = (cwd) => ({ cwd, env: isolatedEnv(), confine: null, writesStore: true });
  const runGit = async (args, { cwd, env, confine, writesStore }) => {
    if (!disk.existsSync(cwd))
      return { code: 1, stdout: "", stderr: `working directory not found: ${cwd}`, missing: false };
    const run = await host.run(options.gitBin, args, { cwd, env, maxBuffer: GIT_OUTPUT_BYTES, confine, writesStore });
    if (run.missing) {
      gitAvailable = false;
      throw failed(CHECKPOINTS_UNAVAILABLE_NO_GIT);
    }
    gitAvailable = true;
    return run;
  };
  const git = async (args, at, doing) => {
    const run = await runGit(args, at);
    const said = run.stderr.trim();
    if (run.code !== 0)
      throw failed(`${doing}: ${said === "" ? `git exited ${String(run.code)}` : said}`);
    return run.stdout;
  };
  const probeGit = async () => {
    if (gitAvailable !== null)
      return gitAvailable;
    try {
      await runGit(["--version"], outside(host.homedir));
    } catch (error) {
      if (gitAvailable !== false)
        throw error;
    }
    return gitAvailable ?? false;
  };
  const sanitizeAgent = (agent) => (agent === "" ? "agent" : agent).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, "_");
  const storeDirFor = (agent, dir) => paths.join(options.base, sanitizeAgent(agent), host.sha256(paths.resolve(dir)).slice(0, 16));
  const initStore = async (gitDir, workdir) => {
    if (disk.existsSync(paths.join(gitDir, "HEAD")))
      return;
    disk.mkdirSync(gitDir, { recursive: true });
    await git(["init", "--bare", "--quiet", gitDir], outside(paths.dirname(gitDir)), "checkpoint store init failed");
    disk.mkdirSync(paths.join(gitDir, "info"), { recursive: true });
    disk.writeFileSync(paths.join(gitDir, "info", "exclude"), CHECKPOINT_EXCLUDES.join(`
`) + `
`);
    disk.writeFileSync(paths.join(gitDir, CHECKPOINT_WORKDIR_MARKER), paths.resolve(workdir) + `
`);
  };
  const snapshotSkipped = (dir) => {
    const abs = paths.resolve(dir);
    if (abs === paths.parse(abs).root || abs === paths.resolve(host.homedir))
      return "it is the filesystem root or the owner's home folder itself";
    if (unsnapshottable.has(abs))
      return "it is a temp directory every process shares";
    if (!disk.existsSync(abs))
      return "it does not exist";
    return disk.statSync(abs).isDirectory() ? null : "it is not a directory";
  };
  const storeRefs = async (gitDir) => {
    const run = await runGit(["for-each-ref", "--sort=-refname", "--format=%(refname)|%(objectname)|%(subject)", CHECKPOINT_REF_PREFIX], storeOnly(gitDir));
    if (run.code !== 0)
      return [];
    return run.stdout.split(`
`).filter(Boolean).map((line) => {
      const [ref = "", id = "", ...rest] = line.split("|");
      return { ref, id, subject: rest.join("|") };
    });
  };
  const stageCurrent = async (gitDir, workdir, confine) => {
    const add = await runGit(["add", "-A", "--ignore-errors"], inTree(gitDir, workdir, confine, true));
    const staged = stagingOutcome(add.code, add.stderr);
    if ("failure" in staged)
      throw failed(staged.failure);
    return { tree: (await git(["write-tree"], storeOnly(gitDir), "checkpoint write-tree failed")).trim(), unreadable: staged.unreadable };
  };
  const snapshot = async ({ agent, dir, turn, reason, confine }) => {
    if (snapshotSkipped(dir) !== null)
      return null;
    const abs = paths.resolve(dir);
    const gitDir = storeDirFor(agent, abs);
    await initStore(gitDir, abs);
    const staged = await stageCurrent(gitDir, abs, confine);
    const store = storeOnly(gitDir);
    const refs = await storeRefs(gitDir);
    const latest = refs[0];
    if (latest !== undefined && (await runGit(["rev-parse", `${latest.id}^{tree}`], store)).stdout.trim() === staged.tree)
      return latest.id;
    const subject = checkpointSubject(turn, checkpointReason(reason, staged.unreadable));
    const sha = (await git(["commit-tree", staged.tree, "-m", subject], store, "checkpoint commit failed")).trim();
    const refName = `${CHECKPOINT_REF_PREFIX}/${String(host.now()).padStart(13, "0")}-${(refSeq++).toString(36).padStart(3, "0")}`;
    await git(["update-ref", refName, sha], store, "checkpoint ref update failed");
    if (refs.length + 1 > keep) {
      for (const stale of (await storeRefs(gitDir)).slice(keep))
        await runGit(["update-ref", "-d", stale.ref], store);
      await runGit(["prune", "--expire=now"], store);
    }
    return sha;
  };
  const requireCheckpoint = async (agent, dir, id) => {
    if (!SHA_RE.test(id))
      throw failed(`invalid checkpoint id: ${id}`);
    const abs = paths.resolve(dir);
    const gitDir = storeDirFor(agent, abs);
    if (!disk.existsSync(paths.join(gitDir, "HEAD")))
      throw failed(`no checkpoints exist for ${abs}`);
    if ((await runGit(["rev-parse", "--verify", `${id}^{commit}`], storeOnly(gitDir))).code !== 0)
      throw failed(`checkpoint not found: ${id}`);
    return { gitDir, abs };
  };
  const diffToCheckpoint = async (gitDir, abs, id, confine) => {
    const current = await stageCurrent(gitDir, abs, confine);
    const out = await git(["diff-tree", "-r", "--name-status", current.tree, `${id}^{tree}`], storeOnly(gitDir), "checkpoint diff failed");
    return out.split(`
`).flatMap((line) => {
      const tab = line.indexOf("\t");
      if (tab < 0)
        return [];
      const status = line.slice(0, tab);
      return [{ path: line.slice(tab + 1), kind: restoreKindOf(status) }];
    });
  };
  const listEntries = async (agent, query) => {
    if (!await probeGit())
      return [];
    const agentBase = paths.join(options.base, sanitizeAgent(agent));
    if (!disk.existsSync(agentBase))
      return [];
    const entries = [];
    for (const name of disk.readdirSync(agentBase)) {
      const gitDir = paths.join(agentBase, name);
      const marker = paths.join(gitDir, CHECKPOINT_WORKDIR_MARKER);
      if (!disk.existsSync(paths.join(gitDir, "HEAD")) || !disk.existsSync(marker))
        continue;
      const workdir = disk.readFileSync(marker, "utf8").trim();
      for (const ref of await storeRefs(gitDir)) {
        const meta = parseCheckpointSubject(ref.subject);
        if (typeof query.turnId === "string" && meta.turnId !== query.turnId)
          continue;
        entries.push({ id: ref.id, dir: workdir, at: checkpointRefTimestampMs(ref.ref), ...meta });
      }
    }
    entries.sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at);
    return entries.slice(0, Math.max(1, query.limit ?? 50));
  };
  const restoreTo = async (agent, dir, id, confine) => {
    if (!await probeGit())
      throw failed(CHECKPOINTS_UNAVAILABLE_NO_GIT);
    const { gitDir, abs } = await requireCheckpoint(agent, dir, id);
    if (!disk.existsSync(abs))
      throw failed(`working directory no longer exists: ${abs}`);
    const files = await diffToCheckpoint(gitDir, abs, id, confine);
    const preRestoreId = await snapshot({ agent, dir: abs, turn: null, reason: "pre-restore", confine });
    const tree = inTree(gitDir, abs, confine, false);
    await git(["read-tree", id], storeOnly(gitDir), "checkpoint read-tree failed");
    const deleted = files.filter((change) => change.kind === "delete").map((change) => change.path);
    for (let at = 0;at < deleted.length; at += RESTORE_DELETE_BATCH) {
      await git(["--literal-pathspecs", "clean", "-f", "-x", "-q", "--", ...deleted.slice(at, at + RESTORE_DELETE_BATCH)], tree, "checkpoint restore failed");
    }
    await git(["checkout-index", "-a", "-f"], tree, "checkpoint restore failed");
    return { dir: abs, id, files, preRestoreId };
  };
  const ensureNow = async (request) => {
    try {
      if (!await probeGit())
        return { skipped: "this machine has no git to take one with" };
      const abs = paths.resolve(request.dir);
      const skipped = snapshotSkipped(abs);
      if (skipped !== null)
        return { skipped };
      const key = `${sanitizeAgent(request.agent)}|${abs}`;
      const turnKey = request.turn?.turnId ?? "no-turn";
      if (turnDone.get(key) === turnKey)
        return null;
      const id = await snapshot({ ...request, dir: abs });
      turnDone.set(key, turnKey);
      return { id };
    } catch (error) {
      const skipped = `the snapshot failed: ${error instanceof Error ? causeText(error) : "it threw something that is not an Error"}`;
      host.log(`checkpoint ${skipped} (the mutation it preceded runs)`);
      return { skipped };
    }
  };
  let queue = Promise.resolve();
  const inOrder = (operation) => {
    const run = queue.then(operation);
    queue = Promise.allSettled([run]);
    return run;
  };
  return {
    status: () => inOrder(async () => await probeGit() ? { available: true } : { available: false, reason: CHECKPOINTS_UNAVAILABLE_NO_GIT }),
    ensure: (request) => inOrder(() => ensureNow(request)),
    mutate: (request, apply) => inOrder(async () => apply(request === null ? null : await ensureNow(request))),
    list: (agent, query) => inOrder(() => listEntries(agent, query)),
    plan: (agent, dir, id, confine) => inOrder(async () => {
      if (!await probeGit())
        throw failed(CHECKPOINTS_UNAVAILABLE_NO_GIT);
      const { gitDir, abs } = await requireCheckpoint(agent, dir, id);
      return { dir: abs, id, files: await diffToCheckpoint(gitDir, abs, id, confine) };
    }),
    restore: (agent, dir, id, confine) => inOrder(() => restoreTo(agent, dir, id, confine)),
    workdirForPath(target, covers = () => true) {
      const abs = paths.resolve(target);
      const candidate = disk.existsSync(abs) && disk.lstatSync(abs).isDirectory() ? abs : paths.dirname(abs);
      const home = paths.resolve(host.homedir);
      const temp = paths.resolve(host.tmpdir);
      const realTemp = disk.existsSync(temp) ? disk.realpathSync(temp) : temp;
      let probe = candidate;
      while (probe !== paths.dirname(probe) && probe !== home && covers(probe)) {
        const real = disk.existsSync(probe) ? disk.realpathSync(probe) : probe;
        if (probe === temp || real === realTemp)
          break;
        if (PROJECT_MARKERS.some((marker) => disk.existsSync(paths.join(probe, marker))))
          return probe;
        probe = paths.dirname(probe);
      }
      return candidate;
    }
  };
}
var PROJECT_MARKERS, SHA_RE, GIT_OUTPUT_BYTES, RESTORE_DELETE_BATCH = 500;
var init_engine = __esm(() => {
  init_format();
  PROJECT_MARKERS = [".git", "package.json", "pyproject.toml", "Cargo.toml", "go.mod", "Makefile", ".hg"];
  SHA_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{4,64}$/i;
  GIT_OUTPUT_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
});

var fs = require("fs");
var path = require("path");
var os = require("os");
var crypto2 = require("crypto");
var sha256Of = (bytes) => crypto2.createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
function checkpointedWrite(msg, { requested, content, options }, checkpoints, write) {
  const view = viewFromFrame(msg);
  const confined = confinedDeviceViewPath(view, requested, "write");
  const covers = (candidate) => view.checkpointDirectory(candidate).why === null;
  const verdict = checkpoints && msg.checkpoint ? view.checkpointDirectory(hintedDir(msg.checkpoint) ?? checkpoints.workdirForPath(confined, covers)) : null;
  const data = options?.encoding === "base64" ? Buffer.from(String(content), "base64") : Buffer.from(String(content));
  return mutation(checkpoints, { view, hint: msg.checkpoint }, coveredBy(verdict), (snapshot) => {
    const answer = write(view, confined, data);
    if (answer.ok === false)
      return answer;
    const skipped = whyUncheckpointed(verdict, snapshot);
    return skipped === null ? answer : { ...answer, uncheckpointed: skipped };
  });
}
function replaceIfDigest(view, target, data, expected) {
  return atJudged(view, target, { createParents: true }, (at) => {
    let found = null;
    try {
      found = sha256Of(readEntry(at));
    } catch (cause) {
      if (cause.code !== "ENOENT")
        throw cause;
    }
    if (found !== expected)
      return { ok: false, sha256: found };
    writeEntry(at, found === null ? fs.constants.O_CREAT | fs.constants.O_EXCL : fs.constants.O_TRUNC, data);
    return { ok: true, sha256: sha256Of(data) };
  });
}
function readEntry(at) {
  const fd = at.open(fs.constants.O_RDONLY);
  try {
    return fs.readFileSync(fd);
  } finally {
    fs.closeSync(fd);
  }
}
function writeEntry(at, flags, data) {
  const fd = at.open(fs.constants.O_WRONLY | flags, 438);
  try {
    fs.writeFileSync(fd, data);
  } finally {
    fs.closeSync(fd);
  }
}
